input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: new research-algorithm tool, staggered difference-in-differences (Callaway & Sant'Anna ATT(g,t), event study, TWFE and Goodman-Bacon decomposition)
errors: First reference.py run wrote csdid's printed tables into the JSON (csdid prints to stdout); fixed by redirecting stdout and writing the file directly.
reference.json first contained NaN (universal base cell), which JSON.parse rejects; now written as null with allow_nan=False.
TWFE clustered SE first differed from pyfixest by 0.1%: the small-sample K is 1 + T, not 1 + (T - 1); fixed and pinned by test.
Page's overall table showed n/a for TWFE (field named beta, not att); caught by a Playwright screenshot before commit.

doc_friction.issue: Says example data must be public domain or openly licensed, but api.census.gov, kff.org, cran and most government data hosts answer 403 through this session's proxy; PyPI and GitHub raw work. A line naming openly licensed data packages on PyPI (causaldata, MIT) as a route would have saved several probes.
gh api search/issues returned HTTP 502 for the duplicate-PR search; list_pull_requests via the GitHub MCP worked. CLAUDE.md's 'search_pull_requests' is not among the loaded MCP tools in this session.

deviations.why: csdid/R did report no Wald pre-test when the group-time covariance is singular; I fall back to a Wald test on the pre-treatment event-time averages and label it, and report none at all when any cohort has one unit (its standard errors omit its own noise).
deviations.did: event-time fallback plus singleton suppression and a minCohort option
deviations.result: castle example: no spurious p=1e-46 pre-test; with minCohort 2 a labelled event-time pre-test (chi-square 20.95, 8 df, p=0.007)

notes: Idea: staggered difference-in-differences as a research tool beside synthetic-control. Engine matches csdid 0.4.5 and pyfixest 0.70.0 within 1e-9 on castle-doctrine data and a simulated panel (ATT(g,t), SEs, simple/event/cohort aggregations, Wald, TWFE + CR1). Finding: on castle data TWFE 0.069 vs CS 0.019, the gap from the base period (e=-1 already +0.097), not forbidden comparisons (2.4% weight); one-unit cohorts make SEs too small. 47 venture tests pass; page checked in Chromium desktop and 390px with no console errors. No separate agent doc in docs/reports: README and research-tools candidates list carry the next steps.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an econometrician building and validating a staggered DiD tool (CS ATT(g,t) with influence functions, aggregations, Wald, bootstrap band, TWFE CR1, Bacon decomposition) against R/Python references plus a web page: about one working week
